_jonas_brother: The new runner is Ulrich Brother, once a shepherd from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a shepherd was any use in a trench. Ulrich Brother said he would find out.

Ulrich Brother took a wrong turn at two identical trench junctions. He decided the route needed names that could be remembered under pressure. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Ulrich Brother shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Ulrich Brother was hit in the forearm at Q-F1. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Rafael Grenades of the Concord (@dove_grenades).
Ulrich Brother is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Ulrich Brother marked the first junction with a spoon and the second with a boot sole. Other runners have begun using the names in their directions.
A newspaper reached Ulrich Brother with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Ulrich Brother fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Someone removed the spoon from Ulrich Brother's junction to eat supper. He retrieved it and nailed it above comfortable reaching height.
blasian117: "You're late," said the corporal when Hugo Blasian arrived on Day 9. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Hugo Blasian fired at a movement across the wire at R-C7. The man went down: Teodor Bachini, badly wounded. Victory at Blackwater Canal. Hugo Blasian let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Hugo Blasian waited for that to change. When it did, Nils Averelle was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Hugo Blasian answered to number 678. Grey Mill has been won. Hugo Blasian listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Hugo Blasian got a letter from Clara. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.

Hugo Blasian had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Leopold "Whistle" Kagr, grazed. Hugo Blasian was hit through the chest at R-C7. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Viktor Detroit of the Concord (@major_detroit313). Hugo Blasian was killed at R-C7 just after dawn. The cup of tea beside him was still hot. Shot by Viktor Detroit of the Concord (@major_detroit313).
The papers say Matthias "Ash" Blasian. The sergeant says he has his cousin's eyes. Hugo Blasian's eyes. Nobody in R-C7 argues.
A loose strip of canvas snapped above Matthias "Ash" Blasian's bunk. He tied it down and received thanks from six apparently sleeping men.
Matthias "Ash" Blasian fired a burst, moved the gun ten yards, and fired again before the enemy could reply. Casimir Man was grazed.
Matthias "Ash" Blasian cut Marek Berkaatilla's hair with a bayonet and a cracked mirror. It is not good. It is, however, short.

The gun at R-C7 jammed twice and fired once. Once was enough: Florian Oaustin, grazed. A bullet went into Matthias "Ash" Blasian's chest just under the heart at R-C7. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Wendel Hans of the Concord (@lezu_hans). Matthias "Ash" Blasian stood up to fix a loose sandbag at R-C7. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Wendel Hans of the Concord (@lezu_hans).
The House of Blasian sent another. Leopold Blasian, older brother of Matthias "Ash" Blasian, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
dersteven_04: On the way to Q-F21, Jakub Dersteven tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.
Jakub Dersteven was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. Victory at Grey Mill. Jakub Dersteven let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
Fresh from training, Jakub Dersteven still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Bastian "Bones" Lastyy, grazed.
Jakub Dersteven shaved using a spoon for a mirror. One side looks ready for inspection. The other looks ready for winter.
Jakub Dersteven (Hegemony) watched Dorian "Ash" Act (Concord) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Ossuary Wood, and held fire until both were gone.
A bullet found Jakub Dersteven at Q-F21, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Bram "Whistle" Rob of the Concord (@rey_rob_ii).
Jakub Dersteven healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Jakub Dersteven wrote a song about the Bone Quarry. Bastian Vigneaux wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
eddholmesss: On the way to R-F18, Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss tried to memorise every turn. By the dugout door, he was simply glad someone else knew the way.

Orders came through: Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a bullet that missed him. The report confirmed the Concord victory at Verdel Ridge. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss noticed regular flashes from a crack in an old stone wall. The position looks obvious enough to make him suspicious.

Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss watched a crack in an old stone wall through another shift. The flash returns at the same angle, even when nothing else moves. Mail came up the line with a letter for Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss drew a line on the bench to settle an argument about space. Everyone obeyed it until the broadest man returned from duty. Day 6. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A clear shot from R-F18. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss gravely wounded Jakub "Brick" Ingfan and slid back down below the parapet.
A second observer helped Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss confirm the trick: a piece of glass, placed to draw fire. The real watching point must be elsewhere.
A round went through Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Shot by Clement Wanter of the Hegemony (@wanter_cz).
Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss rejoined the squad at R-F18. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.

Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile crossed it, Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss fired. Isidor "Ghost" Carnahanwile was grazed. Blackwater Canal is lost. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.

Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss marked a crack in an old stone wall as a decoy on the observation sketch. He passed the warning on and began examining the less obvious gaps. The clerk counted the names twice. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss is number 173 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss wrote to a dog called Bastion on the farm that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Viktor Otroserhuman was gravely wounded at the far edge of no man's land.
Someone asked Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
A supply man offered Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss a damaged gramophone in exchange for help unloading. He accepted before asking whether there were any records.
Tobias "Whistle" Eddholmesss coaxed the gramophone into turning. It plays a waltz with a scratched introduction, but something knocks once every revolution.
egga15627: On Day 9 Gustav Egga took a post at R-C10 that had been empty for two nights. He did not ask why. He shares cigarettes but never smokes, and the men liked him for it. Gustav Egga transferred to the machine gunners. The men in R-C10 said they would miss him. He is only three dugouts away.

The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C10. Gustav Egga has learned to walk bent double. Mail came up the line with a letter for Gustav Egga. Gustav Egga read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Gustav Egga won his boots at cards from a lance corporal in R-C10. The lance corporal wants a rematch. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Gustav Egga is number 620. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Gustav Egga looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.
Rematch. Gustav Egga lost everything he won, plus a dented harmonica. The whole dugout watched.
Gustav Egga was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Gustav Egga won back a dented harmonica and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.

Gustav Egga counted three seconds after the enemy flare went out, then fired at the spot where it had shown a face. Viktor You was badly wounded. At R-C10 the men had a bet on who would hit something first. Gustav Egga won the bet. Gideon Hayden was badly wounded.
The rain did not stop once. Gustav Egga slept standing up, wedged against the wall of R-C10, and dreamt of dry socks.

Gustav Egga had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Anselm Ryan was grazed. Shell splinters peppered R-C10. Gustav Egga picked three out of his sleeve and a fourth out of his arm.
evie.sh207: Tobias "Hollow" Evie reported to T-F8 with a rosary of rough beads sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into T-F8. Tobias "Hollow" Evie has learned to walk bent double.

Tobias "Hollow" Evie was last seen moving toward cover at Blackwater Canal. No one agrees which shelter. The report lists him as missing. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias "Hollow" Evie watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Tobias "Hollow" Evie reappeared at T-F8 carrying a scrap of map from another unit. The route home had been drawn over somebody's shopping list.

Tobias "Hollow" Evie felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F8. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Crawford of the Hegemony (@logan.crawford283).

Wiring party. Tobias "Hollow" Evie held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at T-F8, and everyone came back. Tobias "Hollow" Evie no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Part of the parapet collapsed near Tobias "Hollow" Evie. Repairs started as soon as the dust settled, with one man on watch while the rest worked.

Twenty yards of mud, one gap in the wire, one jump. Tobias "Hollow" Evie landed next to Albin "Shadow" Schizophreni in the Hegemony trench. Only Tobias "Hollow" Evie climbed back out. (@schizophreniawaffles) Tobias "Hollow" Evie went over with the raiders and dropped into the Hegemony trench. Zeno "Hollow" Gsingeis was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@gsingeis)

Tobias "Hollow" Evie had just lit a cigarette at T-F8 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Bram "Mole" Kong of the Hegemony (@jarbeefus_kong). Tobias "Hollow" Evie fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Valentin "Whistle" Kusziko was gravely wounded, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
fade_data35: The draft reached Q-F15 on Day 9. Hugo "Crow" Data was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Hugo "Crow" Data wrote to twin brothers too young to enlist that night and said only: 'We will take it back.' Mail came up the line with a letter for Hugo "Crow" Data. Hugo "Crow" Data read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Hugo "Crow" Data pressed his ear to the tunnel wall under the Drowned Farm and heard it: tapping. Someone is digging toward him. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Hugo "Crow" Data kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A replacement turned out to be from Ashford Vale too. Hugo "Crow" Data and the newcomer argued about the same bakery for half the night.
The tapping under the Drowned Farm is closer. Hugo "Crow" Data and two others work in silence, in socks, by the light of one candle.
On sentry duty Hugo "Crow" Data watched the wire for six hours. Twice he thought the wire watched back.
Hugo "Crow" Data broke through into the enemy gallery at dawn. It was empty. A lamp was still warm. He blew it out and placed the charge.
A flare caught Hugo "Crow" Data halfway through a yawn on the fire step. He stayed still until his jaw ached.

The mine under the Drowned Farm went up at noon. The whole front felt it. Hugo "Crow" Data sat at the tunnel mouth afterwards and did not speak until dark. Hugo "Crow" Data got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.
falloutvam: Benedikt Falloutvam arrived at R-S2 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Benedikt Falloutvam traded a cigarette for a pinch of salt. Supper improved. The argument about the exchange rate did not.
The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Benedikt Falloutvam helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Benedikt Falloutvam brought sandbags forward and found the damage worse than the message had said. The party went back for another load. A letter from home reached Benedikt Falloutvam before dusk. Benedikt Falloutvam read it twice and slept a little easier. Benedikt Falloutvam got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 559. The men who came later will ask about it. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Benedikt Falloutvam during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Benedikt Falloutvam shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Dorian Joshgentile, was grazed.
Benedikt Falloutvam kept a tally of complaints about the tea. The tally ended when somebody asked whether he was volunteering to make it.

Benedikt Falloutvam was hit in the hip at R-S2. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Tobias Htmmci of the Concord (@htmmci). Benedikt Falloutvam was killed at R-S2 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Tobias Htmmci of the Concord (@htmmci).
Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam put his brother's pocket watch beside the bunk. Someone who had known Benedikt Falloutvam helped clear the shelf without saying why.

Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Norbert Alexgreve crossed it, Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam fired. Norbert Alexgreve was badly wounded. Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam had just lit a cigarette at R-S2 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Pavel Rozzyadog of the Concord (@rozzyadog).
The wound on Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam's hand healed crooked, but it healed. He can hold a rifle and a mug, and those are the two things that matter.

A bullet hit Edmund "Doc" Falloutvam's belt buckle at R-S2 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Norbert Tsepnidiss of the Concord (@tsepnidiss._6).
felix.h2007: Ulrich Felix introduced himself as a lamplighter from Ashford Vale. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.

Ulrich Felix reached up to fix a sandbag at Q-F15 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Shot by Dorian Itzwill of the Concord (@itzwill16). Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Felix. Ulrich Felix read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Ulrich Felix walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Ulrich Felix was hit in the hip at Q-F15. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Norbert "Hollow" Viking of the Concord (@nordmann_i_viking). Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Felix. Ulrich Felix read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Felix lay on the stretcher and listened to the surgeon working inside. He tried not to guess what each sound meant. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Felix. Ulrich Felix read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Felix survived the wound and the waiting. He is back at Q-F15, and still will not talk about the nights outside the aid post. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Felix. Ulrich Felix read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Felix and Edmund Szymanski split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair. Mail came up the line with a letter for Ulrich Felix. Ulrich Felix read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Ulrich Felix was hit in the forearm at Q-F15. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Rafael "Lucky" Airsoft of the Concord (@brouwer_airsoft). A letter for Ulrich Felix came all the way from home in nine days. Ulrich Felix counted them on the envelope.

A round came through the loophole Ulrich Felix was watching at Q-F15 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Silas Nthuff of the Concord (@nthuff66). The bearers set Ulrich Felix's stretcher down under a tarp and promised to come back. They came back with another man.
gravesiiclay: Viktor Gravesiiclay arrived on Day 10 as a replacement. The men in P-F23 had been fighting for 10 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.

Viktor Gravesiiclay tried to remember the price of a loaf in Wyvern Cross. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Viktor Gravesiiclay watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
A newspaper reached Viktor Gravesiiclay with the corner torn off. According to the half a sentence that survived, the war was going well.
Viktor Gravesiiclay was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
Viktor Gravesiiclay tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived.
Blast from a trench mortar threw Viktor Gravesiiclay against the trench wall at P-F23. Ringing ears, a split lip, and no intention of leaving.
Viktor Gravesiiclay's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Viktor Gravesiiclay was carrying water up to P-F23 when a bullet hit him in the leg. The water reached the trench. Viktor Gravesiiclay did not. Shot by Dietrich Hutchhll of the Hegemony (@hutchhll). The bearers reached Viktor Gravesiiclay at P-F23 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Dietrich Hutchhll of the Hegemony (@hutchhll).
Another member of the House of Gravesiiclay reached the line: Anselm "Spark" Gravesiiclay. He asked where Viktor Gravesiiclay had slept, then chose a different corner.
harry_betts91774: "You're late," said the corporal when Valentin Betts arrived on Day 6. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."
Valentin Betts and Cyril "Mole" Tylerjohnlas made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Valentin Betts was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success.
Valentin Betts sang under his breath on sentry. Across the wire, very quietly, somebody sang the next line.
Across the wire at Verdel Ridge, Arno Dick of the Hegemony held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Valentin Betts of the Concord held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In S-S8, Valentin Betts listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Valentin Betts as a story about a general. The ending was the same. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Valentin Betts answered to number 406. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Valentin Betts read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Valentin Betts caught a falling mug with his boot. Nobody could say if it was skill or luck, and he did not say either.
Valentin Betts watched fog gather on the wire until every strand carried beads of water. The sentry beside him called it expensive fencing.
Valentin Betts counted the ladles in the pot against the men in the queue. The last serving took some careful scraping.
Isidor "Ash" Tezands and Valentin Betts share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.

A shell landed square in S-S8. They found Valentin Betts alive under the sandbags, barely. Every minute counts now. A shell landed square in the trench at S-S8. Valentin Betts was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.
A letter came with Isidor Betts: "I am Valentin Betts's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

A bullet hit Isidor Betts's belt buckle at S-S8 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Ivo Mulletoperat of the Hegemony (@mulletoperator). Isidor Betts fired a single round through a crack in the enemy's steel plate, a gap no wider than a finger. Leopold Matteozrybak was gravely wounded.
jackal.raf: Nobody asked Florian "Button" Raf why he came. Nobody in R-C9 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Florian "Button" Raf shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Florian "Button" Raf got a letter from Anna. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Florian "Button" Raf answered to number 698. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Florian "Button" Raf could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Florian "Button" Raf wrote back to Anna and tore it up three times. The fourth version says almost nothing, which is how he knows it is the right one.
Florian "Button" Raf dreamt about missing a train. Waking up here felt like a harsh punishment for it.
At the Hanging Bridge, Florian "Button" Raf of the Hegemony and Yann Vee of the Concord spent the morning shooting at the same loose sheet of metal. The sheet kept winning.
No post for Florian "Button" Raf this week. He checks the sack anyway, every day, and pretends he was only looking for tobacco.
A parcel from Anna: socks, a cake gone hard as a brick, and a pressed flower. Florian "Button" Raf ate the cake and kept the flower in a bullet that missed him's place.
A new recruit would not eat with the others. Florian "Button" Raf left a place at the end of the bench and said nothing about it.
masis_xiii: Bastian Xiii signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at R-F13 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
Bastian Xiii answered the first call, number 25 on the rolls. Somebody chalked the number on his helmet. It has not washed off yet.
A clear sky. Bastian Xiii kept his head low all day: on clear days the snipers do not miss.

Bastian Xiii had Pavel Mvuisak of the Concord in his sights at Verdel Ridge for a long second. Pavel Mvuisak was lighting a pipe. Bastian Xiii let the match burn all the way down. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Bastian Xiii watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Bastian Xiii found a clean spot on the table and set his bread on it. Within a minute, someone asked to borrow the spot.

A direct hit on the trench at R-F13. Bastian Xiii was the only one they could still help, and only just. A shell landed square in the trench at R-F13. Bastian Xiii was killed outright. The bearers found nothing to carry.

Hugo Xiii put a rosary of rough beads beside the bunk. Someone who had known Bastian Xiii helped clear the shelf without saying why. First Wave. Hugo Xiii signed when the ink on the posters was still fresh. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a rosary of rough beads. The new duty roster listed Hugo Xiii as a sniper. He kept checking the old roster until someone took it down.

The blast lifted Hugo Xiii off his feet at R-F13. He came round with a bloody nose and an empty rifle and went back to work. A letter from home found Hugo Xiii before the night shift. Hugo Xiii folded it small and kept it close. Word came down the line: Hill 304 is ours. Hugo Xiii shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Hugo Xiii no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
Dawn watch. Hugo Xiii put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Bram Satalik, grazed.

Hugo Xiii mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. A letter from home found Hugo Xiii before the night shift. Hugo Xiii folded it small and kept it close.
Hugo Xiii caught himself counting portions before counting people. He started again. A letter from home found Hugo Xiii before the night shift. Hugo Xiii folded it small and kept it close.

Hugo Xiii went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At R-F13 they left Hugo Xiii behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Karel Pavla of the Concord (@pavla.9_).

Gustav "Ghost" Xiii asked about Hugo Xiii on arriving at R-F13. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. Gustav "Ghost" Xiii's First Wave ribbon drew a question at supper. He remembered the queue at the depot more clearly than the speech. Gustav "Ghost" Xiii reported for duty as a sniper. The new kit was heavier than the explanation of how to use it.

Gustav "Ghost" Xiii felt a hard tug at his hip at R-F13. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Clement "Tin" Natakhtasha of the Concord (@natakhtasha). A letter from home found Gustav "Ghost" Xiii before the night shift. Gustav "Ghost" Xiii folded it small and kept it close. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Gustav "Ghost" Xiii could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.

Gustav "Ghost" Xiii's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at R-F13 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. A letter from home found Gustav "Ghost" Xiii before the night shift. Gustav "Ghost" Xiii folded it small and kept it close.
Gustav "Ghost" Xiii took the shot at four hundred yards. The spotter whispered the result: Zeno "Lucky" Nugg, gravely wounded.

Gustav "Ghost" Xiii spent the night in no man's land with pliers and a roll of wire. Every flare meant lying flat in the mud. The gap at R-F13 is closed now. A bullet went through Gustav "Ghost" Xiii's upper arm at R-F13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Oskar Knightowlvt of the Concord (@knightowlvt). A letter from home found Gustav "Ghost" Xiii before the night shift. Gustav "Ghost" Xiii folded it small and kept it close.
Someone moved Gustav "Ghost" Xiii's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
The medics had to choose who got the last bed. They did not choose Gustav "Ghost" Xiii. He died on the stretcher before morning.
The House of Xiii sent Matthias "Owl" Xiii after Gustav "Ghost" Xiii. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
Matthias "Owl" Xiii tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
regpal_dorjee_bhutia: In Millbank, Arno "Whistle" Bhutia was a farmhand. In N-F1, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a farmhand again.
Arno "Whistle" Bhutia fixed the strap on Gustav Joodiizzzlee's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Arno "Whistle" Bhutia kept Arno Ldscheffelma awake all night with questions about home: the street, the shop, the dog. By morning Whistle could have walked there blind.

Arno "Whistle" Bhutia took a bullet through the hand and another through the forearm at N-F1, seconds apart. The bearers carried him back with the arm held up like a flag. Shot by Isidor Lee of the Hegemony (@michael_lee6767). Arno "Whistle" Bhutia looked over the parapet at N-F1 for one second too long. The bullet came before the sound. Shot by Isidor Lee of the Hegemony (@michael_lee6767).
Teodor "Brick" Bhutia arrived carrying the family name of Arno "Whistle" Bhutia. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Someone in N-F1 asked Teodor "Brick" Bhutia about Millbank. He talked for an hour. Nobody interrupted.
the_limit_m: Oskar Limit came up the line with a key to a house that is no longer there and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud.
thejazzbutcher: Viktor Thejazzbutch reached P-F5 expecting a speech. The welcome consisted of a mug, a space on a bench and directions to the latrine. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Viktor Thejazzbutch helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
Viktor Thejazzbutch mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted.
Viktor Thejazzbutch moved to a new hide at P-F5 before dawn, because the old one had been too lucky. The first shot from the new one found Pavel Photography, gravely wounded.
Promoted to Lance Corporal, Viktor Thejazzbutch had to settle an argument he had been happily taking part in five minutes earlier.
An unexploded shell lay beside the approach trench. Viktor Thejazzbutch helped steer the carrying party around it and was glad to leave the problem to somebody else.

The raid hit the Concord line at the darkest hour. Viktor Thejazzbutch fought Gideon "Button" Daremiamor in a trench no wider than a door. Viktor Thejazzbutch came home with Gideon "Button" Daremiamor's cap badge. (@daremiamor)
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Viktor Thejazzbutch lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
thswastim05: Edmund Thswastim signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at Q-F8 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Edmund Thswastim helped stack spare sandbags at Q-F8. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Edmund Thswastim was found at the bottom of the trench at Q-F8, hit in the head, helmet split open. He is breathing in short, loud gasps. Shot by Florian Jimjamjom of the Hegemony (@jimjamjom_). Edmund Thswastim fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Casimir Oyamat was badly wounded. Edmund Thswastim ate breakfast without a word. Edmund Thswastim finally has a bed in the hospital dugout. A real blanket, a lamp, and a surgeon who has not slept. The bleeding has stopped. Edmund Thswastim asked for a pencil and paper, and the orderlies took it as the best sign they had seen. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Edmund Thswastim watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The bearers moved Edmund Thswastim's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule.
Edmund Thswastim spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to Q-F8.
Edmund Thswastim won a gold tooth at cards from a lance corporal in Q-F8. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Rematch. Edmund Thswastim lost everything he won, plus a photograph gone soft at the edges. The whole dugout watched.

Night raid. Edmund Thswastim crossed no man's land, saw the enemy sentry too late to reach, and came back without a scratch. Next time, says Edmund Thswastim. Back from the raid, Edmund Thswastim found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'Hello' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
Third game, by candlelight, with the shelling for a clock. Edmund Thswastim won back a photograph gone soft at the edges and nothing else. He says that was all he was playing for.
tony2swag_: On Day 9, Edmund Swag arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Edmund Swag stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

A bullet clipped Edmund Swag's helmet at T-F3 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Silas "Spark" Tallas of the Hegemony (@tallas154). From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Edmund Swag wrote to a sweetheart who has stopped writing that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Edmund Swag no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
The trench wall shook against Edmund Swag's shoulder during the bombardment. He pressed both feet into the boards and waited for the next hit.
Arno Shitsherlock (Hegemony) and Edmund Swag (Concord) watched each other through the same loophole at the Bone Quarry for an hour. Neither fired. Neither will explain why.
A shell landed close to T-F3. When the dust settled Edmund Swag was still there, holding a key to a house that is no longer there, laughing without sound.
An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Edmund Swag added a leak above the man's head in pencil.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Edmund Swag fired, and Jakub Damocles was grazed.
